```{r setup, include=FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

first_existing_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_ else hit[[1]]
}

pull_first_existing <- function(df, candidates, default = NA_character_) {
  hit <- first_existing_col(df, candidates)
  if (is.na(hit)) {
    rep(default, nrow(df))
  } else {
    df[[hit]]
  }
}

clean_location_code <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_replace_all("[[:space:]]+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9_]+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("_+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
}

# Collapse all refugee settlement/site codes recorded in Adjumani district to one tracker settlement.
# The Kobo tool stores individual Adjumani sites as codes such as adjumani_agojo,
# adjumani_ayilo_i, adjumani_nyumanzi, adjumani_pagirinya, etc., while the approved
# sampling target is for Adjumani settlement as a whole.
standardise_settlement_for_tracker <- function(settlement, district = NA_character_) {
  settlement_chr <- as.character(settlement)
  district_key <- clean_location_code(district)
  settlement_key <- clean_location_code(settlement_chr)

  is_adjumani_settlement <-
    !is.na(district_key) & district_key == "adjumani" &
    !is.na(settlement_key) & settlement_key != ""

  settlement_chr[is_adjumani_settlement] <- "adjumani"
  settlement_chr
}

parse_datetime_safe <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXct") || inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(as.POSIXct(x, tz = "Africa/Kampala"))

  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  x_chr <- stringr::str_trim(x_chr)
  x_chr[x_chr == ""] <- NA_character_
  x_chr <- stringr::str_replace_all(x_chr, "T", " ")
  x_chr <- stringr::str_replace(x_chr, "Z$", "+0000")

  suppressWarnings(
    parse_date_time(
      x_chr,
      orders = c(
        "ymd HMS z", "ymd HM z", "ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd",
        "dmy HMS z", "dmy HM z", "dmy HMS", "dmy HM", "dmy",
        "mdy HMS z", "mdy HM z", "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "mdy",
        "Ymd HMS z", "Ymd HM z", "Ymd HMS", "Ymd HM"
      ),
      tz = "Africa/Kampala"
    )
  )
}

safe_date <- function(x) {
  out <- suppressWarnings(as_date(parse_datetime_safe(x)))
  if (all(is.na(out))) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as_date(x))
  }
  out
}

parse_duration_to_minutes <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) return(numeric())

  if (inherits(x, "difftime")) {
    return(as.numeric(lubridate::time_length(x, unit = "min")))
  }

  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  x_chr <- stringr::str_trim(x_chr)
  x_chr[x_chr == ""] <- NA_character_

  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))

  # Handle durations stored as HH:MM:SS or MM:SS.
  hms_like <- !is.na(x_chr) & stringr::str_detect(x_chr, "^[0-9]+:[0-9]{1,2}(:[0-9]{1,2})?$")
  if (any(hms_like, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    hms_parts <- stringr::str_split(x_chr[hms_like], ":", simplify = FALSE)
    out[hms_like] <- vapply(hms_parts, function(z) {
      z <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z))
      if (length(z) == 3) {
        z[1] * 60 + z[2] + z[3] / 60
      } else if (length(z) == 2) {
        z[1] + z[2] / 60
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    }, numeric(1))
  }

  out
}

clean_survey_duration_minutes <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  x[!is.finite(x)] <- NA_real_
  # Remove impossible or non-useful durations for average survey-time reporting.
  x[x <= 0 | x > 1440] <- NA_real_
  x
}

mean_survey_time_minutes <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_survey_duration_minutes(x)
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

format_survey_time_minutes <- function(x) {
  x <- mean_survey_time_minutes(x)
  if (is.na(x)) {
    "Not available"
  } else {
    as.character(round(x, 0))
  }
}

read_optional_csv <- function(paths) {
  existing <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(existing) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  readr::read_csv(existing[[1]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    janitor::clean_names()
}

safe_dt <- function(x, page_length = 15, filter = "none") {
  x <- as_tibble(x)
  if (nrow(x) == 0 && ncol(x) == 0) {
    x <- tibble(message = "No records available")
  }
  DT::datatable(
    x,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = filter,
    options = list(
      pageLength = page_length,
      autoWidth = TRUE,
      initComplete = JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "$(this.api().table().header()).css({'background-color': '#333', 'color': '#fff'});",
        "}"
      )
    )
  )
}

dt_set_options <- function(x) {
  DT::datatable(
    x,
    options = list(
      autoWidth = FALSE,
      dom = "t",
      list(list(width = "20%", targets = list(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)))
    )
  )
}

dt_with_modified_options <- function(x) {
  safe_dt(x, page_length = 15)
}

dt_options_fewcols <- function(x) {
  safe_dt(x, page_length = 10)
}

dt_enum_performance_options <- function(x) {
  x <- as_tibble(x)
  if (nrow(x) == 0 && ncol(x) == 0) {
    x <- tibble(message = "No records available")
  }
  DT::datatable(
    x,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(
      columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-center", targets = list(1, 2))),
      pageLength = 50,
      initComplete = JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "$(this.api().table().header()).css({'background-color': '#333', 'color': '#fff'});",
        "}"
      ),
      order = list(list(1, "desc"), list(0, "asc"), list(3, "desc"))
    )
  )
}

standardise_tracker_main_data <- function(df) {
  
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  df <- as_tibble(df)
  
  uuid_col <- first_existing_col(
    df,
    c("uuid", "_uuid", "_id", "instance_name", "_submission__id", "_submission_id")
  )
  
  start_col <- first_existing_col(
    df,
    c("start", "start_time", "begin_time", "_start", "submission_time", "_submission_time")
  )
  
  end_col <- first_existing_col(
    df,
    c("end", "end_time", "stop_time", "_end", "submission_time", "_submission_time")
  )
  
  date_col <- first_existing_col(
    df,
    c("today", "todays_date", "start_date", "survey_date", "submission_time", "_submission_time", "start")
  )
  
  latitude_col <- first_existing_col(
    df,
    c(
      "latitude", "lat",
      "_geopoint_latitude", "geopoint_latitude",
      "gps_latitude", "_gps_latitude",
      "location_latitude", "coordinates_latitude"
    )
  )
  
  longitude_col <- first_existing_col(
    df,
    c(
      "longitude", "lon", "lng",
      "_geopoint_longitude", "geopoint_longitude",
      "gps_longitude", "_gps_longitude",
      "location_longitude", "coordinates_longitude"
    )
  )
  
  out <- df %>%
    mutate(
      uuid = if (!is.na(uuid_col)) as.character(.data[[uuid_col]]) else as.character(row_number()),
      district = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("admin2", "district", "district_name"))),
      settlement = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("admin3_setlement", "settlement", "refugee_settlement"))),
      sub_county_division = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("admin3", "sub_county_division", "sub_county", "division"))),
      zone = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("admin4", "refugee_settlement_zone", "settlement_zone", "zone"))),
      hoh_type = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("hoh_type", "status", "population_group"))),
      resp_gender = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("resp_gender", "respondent_gender", "gender"))),
      resp_age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pull_first_existing(., c("resp_age", "respondent_age")))),
      hh_size = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pull_first_existing(., c("hh_size", "household_size")))),
      enumerator_id = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("enum_id", "enumerator_id", "enumerator", "username", "_submitted_by"))),
      enum_gender = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("enum_gender", "enumerator_gender"))),
      point_number = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("point_number", "pt_num", "sample_point", "cluster_id"))),
      start_time = if (!is.na(start_col)) parse_datetime_safe(.data[[start_col]]) else as.POSIXct(NA),
      end_time = if (!is.na(end_col)) parse_datetime_safe(.data[[end_col]]) else as.POSIXct(NA),
      start_date = if (!is.na(date_col)) safe_date(.data[[date_col]]) else safe_date(start_time),
      latitude = if (!is.na(latitude_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[latitude_col]])) else NA_real_,
      longitude = if (!is.na(longitude_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[longitude_col]])) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      start_date = if_else(is.na(start_date), as_date(start_time), start_date),
      population_group = case_when(
        str_detect(str_to_lower(hoh_type), "refugee") ~ "refugee",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(hoh_type), "host") ~ "host_community",
        TRUE ~ hoh_type
      ),
      # The sampling frame treats all Adjumani refugee sites as one settlement target.
      settlement = standardise_settlement_for_tracker(settlement, district),
      district_key = clean_location_code(district),
      settlement_key = clean_location_code(settlement),
      sub_county_division_key = clean_location_code(sub_county_division)
    )
  
  duration_col <- first_existing_col(
    out,
    c("duration_minutes", "int_survey_time_interval", "survey_time_minutes", "duration")
  )

  duration_from_column <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(out))
  if (!is.na(duration_col)) {
    duration_from_column <- parse_duration_to_minutes(out[[duration_col]])
  }

  duration_from_start_end <- ifelse(
    !is.na(out$start_time) & !is.na(out$end_time),
    lubridate::time_length(out$end_time - out$start_time, unit = "min"),
    NA_real_
  )

  out <- out %>%
    mutate(
      int.survey_time_interval = dplyr::coalesce(duration_from_column, duration_from_start_end),
      int.survey_time_interval = clean_survey_duration_minutes(int.survey_time_interval),
      int.survey_time_interval = ceiling(int.survey_time_interval)
    )
  
  out
}

standardise_tracker_cleaning_log <- function(cl, support_data) {
  
  if (is.null(cl)) {
    cl <- tibble()
  }
  
  if (is.list(cl) && !is.data.frame(cl) && "cleaning_log" %in% names(cl)) {
    cl <- cl$cleaning_log
  }
  
  if (!is.data.frame(cl) || nrow(cl) == 0) {
    cl <- tibble(
      dataset = character(),
      uuid = character(),
      parent_uuid = character(),
      repeat_index = character(),
      question = character(),
      old_value = character(),
      new_value = character(),
      change_type = character(),
      issue = character(),
      check_id = character()
    )
  }
  
  cl <- as_tibble(cl) %>%
    janitor::clean_names()
  
  required <- c(
    "dataset", "uuid", "parent_uuid", "repeat_index", "question",
    "old_value", "new_value", "change_type", "issue", "check_id",
    "check_to_perform", "columns_to_clean", "notes"
  )
  
  for (cc in setdiff(required, names(cl))) {
    cl[[cc]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  support <- support_data %>%
    select(
      uuid,
      hoh_type_support = hoh_type,
      population_group_support = population_group,
      district_support = district,
      settlement_support = settlement,
      sub_county_division_support = sub_county_division,
      zone_support = zone,
      point_number_support = point_number,
      latitude_support = latitude,
      longitude_support = longitude,
      enumerator_id_support = enumerator_id,
      start_time_support = start_time,
      start_date_support = start_date
    )
  
  cl %>%
    mutate(
      uuid = as.character(uuid),
      parent_uuid = as.character(parent_uuid),
      question = str_remove(as.character(question), "_converted$"),
      columns_to_clean = str_remove(as.character(columns_to_clean), "_converted$"),
      change_type = if_else(is.na(change_type) | change_type == "", "no_action", as.character(change_type))
    ) %>%
    left_join(support, by = "uuid") %>%
    mutate(
      district = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("admin2", "district", "district_name", "district_support"))),
      settlement = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("admin3_setlement", "settlement", "refugee_settlement", "settlement_support"))),
      sub_county_division = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("admin3", "sub_county_division", "sub_county_division_support"))),
      zone = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("admin4", "zone", "zone_support"))),
      hoh_type = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("hoh_type", "hoh_type_support"))),
      population_group = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("population_group", "population_group_support"))),
      point_number = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("point_number", "point_number_support"))),
      latitude = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pull_first_existing(., c("latitude", "latitude_support")))),
      longitude = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pull_first_existing(., c("longitude", "longitude_support")))),
      enumerator_id = as.character(pull_first_existing(., c("enum_id", "enumerator_id", "enumerator_id_support", "username", "_submitted_by"))),
      start_time = parse_datetime_safe(pull_first_existing(., c("start_time", "start_time_support", "_submission_time", "submission_time"))),
      start_date = safe_date(pull_first_existing(., c("start_date", "start_date_support", "today", "_submission_time", "submission_time"))),
      population_group = case_when(
        str_detect(str_to_lower(hoh_type), "refugee") ~ "refugee",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(hoh_type), "host") ~ "host_community",
        TRUE ~ population_group
      ),
      # Use the same Adjumani roll-up in cleaning-log deletion counts and issue summaries.
      settlement = standardise_settlement_for_tracker(settlement, district),
      district_key = clean_location_code(district),
      settlement_key = clean_location_code(settlement),
      sub_county_division_key = clean_location_code(sub_county_division)
    )
}

apply_change_responses <- function(df, change_log) {
  
  if (!is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0 || !is.data.frame(change_log) || nrow(change_log) == 0) {
    return(df)
  }
  
  changes <- change_log %>%
    filter(
      change_type == "change_response",
      !is.na(new_value),
      !is.na(uuid),
      !is.na(question),
      !str_detect(question, "\\/")
    ) %>%
    filter(question %in% names(df)) %>%
    select(uuid, question, new_value)
  
  if (nrow(changes) == 0) {
    return(df)
  }
  
  out <- df
  
  for (ii in seq_len(nrow(changes))) {
    
    current_uuid <- as.character(changes$uuid[[ii]])
    current_question <- as.character(changes$question[[ii]])
    current_value <- changes$new_value[[ii]]
    
    row_hit <- which(as.character(out$uuid) == current_uuid)
    
    if (length(row_hit) == 0 || !current_question %in% names(out)) {
      next
    }
    
    if (is.numeric(out[[current_question]])) {
      out[[current_question]][row_hit] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(current_value))
    } else if (inherits(out[[current_question]], "Date")) {
      out[[current_question]][row_hit] <- suppressWarnings(as_date(current_value))
    } else if (inherits(out[[current_question]], "POSIXct") || inherits(out[[current_question]], "POSIXt")) {
      out[[current_question]][row_hit] <- parse_datetime_safe(current_value)
    } else {
      out[[current_question]][row_hit] <- as.character(current_value)
    }
  }
  
  out
}

prepare_refugee_samples <- function(sample_df, data_df) {
  
  if (is.data.frame(sample_df) && nrow(sample_df) > 0) {
    
    settlement_col <- first_existing_col(sample_df, c("settlement", "refugee_settlement", "admin3_setlement"))
    district_col <- first_existing_col(sample_df, c("district", "district_name", "admin2"))
    with_buffer_col <- first_existing_col(sample_df, c("sample_size_with_buffer", "samples_with_buffer", "required_samples_with_buffer"))
    without_buffer_col <- first_existing_col(sample_df, c("sample_size_without_buffer", "samples_without_buffer", "required_samples_without_buffer"))
    
    out <- sample_df %>%
      mutate(
        district = if (!is.na(district_col)) as.character(.data[[district_col]]) else NA_character_,
        settlement = if (!is.na(settlement_col)) as.character(.data[[settlement_col]]) else NA_character_,
        # Keep approved refugee targets on the same settlement coding used for completed surveys.
        settlement = standardise_settlement_for_tracker(settlement, district),
        settlement_key = clean_location_code(settlement),
        required_samples_with_buffer = if (!is.na(with_buffer_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[with_buffer_col]])) else NA_real_,
        samples_without_buffer = if (!is.na(without_buffer_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[without_buffer_col]])) else NA_real_
      ) %>%
      group_by(district, settlement, settlement_key) %>%
      summarise(
        required_samples_with_buffer = sum(required_samples_with_buffer, na.rm = TRUE),
        samples_without_buffer = sum(samples_without_buffer, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    return(out)
  }
  
  data_df %>%
    filter(population_group == "refugee") %>%
    distinct(district, settlement, settlement_key) %>%
    mutate(
      required_samples_with_buffer = NA_real_,
      samples_without_buffer = NA_real_
    )
}

prepare_host_samples <- function(sample_df, data_df) {
  
  # Host-community targets in the Word document are district-level targets.
  # We therefore prepare and join host targets by district_key, not by sub-county.
  if (is.data.frame(sample_df) && nrow(sample_df) > 0) {
    
    district_col <- first_existing_col(sample_df, c("district", "district_name", "admin2"))
    with_buffer_col <- first_existing_col(sample_df, c("sample_size_with_buffer", "samples_with_buffer", "required_samples_with_buffer"))
    without_buffer_col <- first_existing_col(sample_df, c("sample_size_without_buffer", "samples_without_buffer", "required_samples_without_buffer"))
    
    out <- sample_df %>%
      mutate(
        district = if (!is.na(district_col)) as.character(.data[[district_col]]) else NA_character_,
        district_key = clean_location_code(district),
        samples_with_buffer = if (!is.na(with_buffer_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[with_buffer_col]])) else NA_real_,
        samples_without_buffer = if (!is.na(without_buffer_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[without_buffer_col]])) else NA_real_
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(district_key), district_key != "") %>%
      group_by(district, district_key) %>%
      summarise(
        samples_with_buffer = sum(samples_with_buffer, na.rm = TRUE),
        samples_without_buffer = sum(samples_without_buffer, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    return(out)
  }
  
  data_df %>%
    filter(population_group == "host_community") %>%
    distinct(district, district_key) %>%
    mutate(
      samples_with_buffer = NA_real_,
      samples_without_buffer = NA_real_
    )
}

ensure_gender_columns <- function(df) {
  
  gender_cols <- c("male", "female", "other", "dnk", "pnta")
  
  for (cc in gender_cols) {
    if (!cc %in% names(df)) {
      df[[cc]] <- 0L
    }
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      total_known_gender = male + female,
      `male(%)` = if_else(total_known_gender > 0, round(male / total_known_gender * 100, 0), NA_real_),
      `female(%)` = if_else(total_known_gender > 0, round(female / total_known_gender * 100, 0), NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    select(-total_known_gender)
}

  "Kampala",      79,                       150
)

if (exists("raw_data_list") && is.list(raw_data_list) && "Submissions" %in% names(raw_data_list)) {
  df_tool_data_raw <- raw_data_list$Submissions
} else if (exists("data_hh_main") && is.data.frame(data_hh_main)) {
  df_tool_data_raw <- data_hh_main
} else if (exists("combined_log") && is.list(combined_log) && "checked_dataset" %in% names(combined_log)) {
  df_tool_data_raw <- combined_log$checked_dataset
} else if (exists("path_data") && file.exists(path_data)) {
  export_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(path_data)
  main_sheet <- if ("Submissions" %in% export_sheets) "Submissions" else export_sheets[[1]]
  df_tool_data_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(path_data, sheet = main_sheet, .name_repair = "unique_quiet")
  if (exists("standardise_column_names", mode = "function")) {
    df_tool_data_raw <- standardise_column_names(df_tool_data_raw)
  }
} else {
  stop("No main MSNA 2026 dataset was found. Run scripts 1-4 before rendering this RMarkdown report.", call. = FALSE)
}

df_tool_data <- standardise_tracker_main_data(df_tool_data_raw)

df_days_for_data_collection <- df_tool_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
  distinct(start_date) %>%
  arrange(start_date) %>%
  pull(start_date)

if (length(df_days_for_data_collection) == 0) {
  df_days_for_data_collection <- Sys.Date()
}

df_data_support_cl_log <- df_tool_data %>%
  select(
    uuid,
    hoh_type,
    population_group,
    district,
    settlement,
    sub_county_division,
    zone,
    point_number,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    enumerator_id,
    start_time,
    start_date
  )

if (exists("combined_log") && is.list(combined_log) && "cleaning_log" %in% names(combined_log)) {
  df_cl_log_raw <- combined_log$cleaning_log
} else if (exists("cleaning_log_template") && is.data.frame(cleaning_log_template)) {
  df_cl_log_raw <- cleaning_log_template
} else if (exists("cleaning_log") && is.data.frame(cleaning_log)) {
  df_cl_log_raw <- cleaning_log
} else if (exists("combined_log_to_export") && is.data.frame(combined_log_to_export)) {
  df_cl_log_raw <- combined_log_to_export
} else {
  df_cl_log_raw <- tibble()
}

df_cl_log <- standardise_tracker_cleaning_log(df_cl_log_raw, df_data_support_cl_log) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(string = as.character(point_number), pattern = fixed("test", ignore_case = TRUE)))

# updated tool data after applying reviewed change_response rows already available in the current cleaning log
df_updated_tool_data <- apply_change_responses(df_tool_data, df_cl_log)

# recompute derived reporting columns after possible changes
df_updated_tool_data <- standardise_tracker_main_data(df_updated_tool_data)

df_enum_performance <- df_updated_tool_data

df_settlement_samples_required <- prepare_refugee_samples(df_refugee_samples, df_updated_tool_data)
df_host_samples_required <- prepare_host_samples(df_host_samples, df_updated_tool_data)

df_for_colnames <- df_settlement_samples_required %>%
  select(district, settlement, settlement_key) %>%
  distinct()

df_for_host_colnames <- df_host_samples_required %>%
  select(district, district_key) %>%
  distinct()
```

## Summary on the surveys done

>There are **`r nrow(df_updated_tool_data)`** total number of surveys done as of **`r df_days_for_data_collection[length(df_days_for_data_collection)]`**.

>The average survey time for all the data is: **`r format_survey_time_minutes(df_enum_performance$int.survey_time_interval)`** Minutes

### Settlements:  **`r df_updated_tool_data %>% filter(population_group == "refugee") %>% nrow()`** surveys

```{r, echo = FALSE}
df_refugee_samp_per_settlement <- df_settlement_samples_required %>%
  group_by(district, settlement, settlement_key) %>%
  summarise(
    required_samples_with_buffer = sum(required_samples_with_buffer, na.rm = TRUE),
    samples_without_buffer = sum(samples_without_buffer, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_cl_surveys_for_deletion_refugee <- df_cl_log %>%
  filter(population_group == "refugee", change_type == "remove_survey") %>%
  filter(!is.na(settlement_key), settlement_key != "") %>%
  distinct(uuid, settlement_key) %>%
  count(settlement_key, name = "surveys_for_deletion")

df_refugee_completed <- df_updated_tool_data %>%
  filter(population_group == "refugee") %>%
  filter(!is.na(settlement_key), settlement_key != "") %>%
  group_by(district, settlement, settlement_key) %>%
  summarise(surveys_completed = n(), .groups = "drop")

df_refugee_progress <- df_refugee_completed %>%
  full_join(df_refugee_samp_per_settlement, by = "settlement_key", suffix = c("", "_sample")) %>%
  mutate(
    district = coalesce(district, district_sample),
    settlement = coalesce(settlement, settlement_sample)
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("district_sample", "settlement_sample"))) %>%
  left_join(df_cl_surveys_for_deletion_refugee, by = "settlement_key") %>%
  mutate(
    surveys_completed = replace_na(surveys_completed, 0L),
    surveys_for_deletion = replace_na(surveys_for_deletion, 0L),
    surveys_after_deletion = surveys_completed - surveys_for_deletion,
    remaining_surveys_with_buffer = required_samples_with_buffer - surveys_after_deletion,
    remaining_surveys_no_buffer = samples_without_buffer - surveys_after_deletion
  ) %>%
  arrange(district, settlement) %>%
  select(
    district,
    settlement,
    surveys_completed,
    surveys_for_deletion,
    surveys_after_deletion,
    required_samples_with_buffer,
    samples_without_buffer,
    remaining_surveys_with_buffer,
    remaining_surveys_no_buffer
  )

df_refugee_progress %>%
  dt_with_modified_options()
```

### Host community: **`r df_updated_tool_data %>% filter(population_group == "host_community") %>% nrow()`** surveys

```{r, echo = FALSE}
df_host_samp_per_district <- df_host_samples_required %>%
  group_by(district, district_key) %>%
  summarise(
    samples_with_buffer = sum(samples_with_buffer, na.rm = TRUE),
    samples_without_buffer = sum(samples_without_buffer, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_cl_surveys_for_deletion_host <- df_cl_log %>%
  filter(population_group == "host_community", change_type == "remove_survey") %>%
  mutate(district_key = clean_location_code(district)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(district_key), district_key != "") %>%
  distinct(uuid, district_key) %>%
  count(district_key, name = "surveys_for_deletion")

df_host_completed <- df_updated_tool_data %>%
  filter(population_group == "host_community") %>%
  filter(!is.na(district_key), district_key != "") %>%
  group_by(district, district_key) %>%
  summarise(surveys_completed = n(), .groups = "drop")

df_host_progress <- df_host_completed %>%
  full_join(df_host_samp_per_district, by = "district_key", suffix = c("", "_sample")) %>%
  mutate(
    district = coalesce(district, district_sample)
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("district_sample"))) %>%
  left_join(df_cl_surveys_for_deletion_host, by = "district_key") %>%
  mutate(
    surveys_completed = replace_na(surveys_completed, 0L),
    surveys_for_deletion = replace_na(surveys_for_deletion, 0L),
    surveys_after_deletion = surveys_completed - surveys_for_deletion,
    remaining_surveys_with_buffer = samples_with_buffer - surveys_after_deletion,
    remaining_surveys_no_buffer = samples_without_buffer - surveys_after_deletion
  ) %>%
  arrange(district) %>%
  select(
    district,
    surveys_completed,
    surveys_for_deletion,
    surveys_after_deletion,
    samples_with_buffer,
    samples_without_buffer,
    remaining_surveys_with_buffer,
    remaining_surveys_no_buffer
  )

df_host_progress %>%
  dt_with_modified_options()
```

### Daily enumerator performance

```{r, echo = FALSE}
df_enum_performance %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date), !is.na(enumerator_id), enumerator_id != "") %>%
  group_by(district, start_date, enumerator_id) %>%
  summarise(
    number_of_interviews_done = n(),
    `average_survey_time(minutes)` = {
      avg_time <- mean_survey_time_minutes(int.survey_time_interval)
      ifelse(is.na(avg_time), NA_real_, round(avg_time, 0))

  ) %>%
  dt_enum_performance_options()
```

### Map of surveys for deletion

```{r, echo = FALSE, out.width="100%"}
df_deletion_map <- df_cl_log %>%
  filter(change_type == "remove_survey") %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  group_by(uuid, hoh_type, population_group, sub_county_division, settlement, latitude, longitude) %>%
  summarise(
    start_time = paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(start_time))), collapse = " : "),
    enumerator_id = paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(enumerator_id))), collapse = " : "),
    district = paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(district))), collapse = " : "),
    point_number = paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(point_number))), collapse = " : "),
    change_type = paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(change_type))), collapse = " : "),
    question = paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(question))), collapse = " : "),
    old_value = paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(old_value))), collapse = " : "),
    new_value = paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(new_value))), collapse = " : "),
    issue = paste(unique(na.omit(as.character(issue))), collapse = " : "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(
    int.hoh_type = ifelse(
      population_group == "refugee",
      glue("{population_group}_{settlement}"),
      glue("{population_group}_{sub_county_division}")
    )
  )

if (nrow(df_deletion_map) == 0) {
  
  tibble(message = "No surveys for deletion with valid latitude/longitude were found.") %>%
    dt_options_fewcols()
  
} else {
  
  labels_pts <- sprintf(
    "<strong>Population group and location: %s</strong><br/>
      Point Number: <strong>%s</strong><br/>
      Issue: <strong>%s</strong><br/>
      Enumerator ID: <strong>%s</strong>",
    df_deletion_map$int.hoh_type,
    df_deletion_map$point_number,
    df_deletion_map$issue,
    df_deletion_map$enumerator_id
  ) %>%
    lapply(htmltools::HTML)
  
  leaflet(df_deletion_map) %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      ~longitude,
      ~latitude,
      popup = labels_pts,
      radius = 10,
      color = "red",
      stroke = FALSE,
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      label = labels_pts,
      clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions()
    )
}
```
